newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-INDIA TO PLAY ONE-DAY SERIES IN PAKISTAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA TO PLAY ONE-DAY SERIES IN PAKISTAN.

text.p: India are to make their first cricket tour of Pakistan in eight years to play three one-day internationals, the official APP news agency reported on Saturday.
It quoted a Pakistan Cricket Board announcement in Lahore, saying India would play their first match in Karachi on September 28, and the second and third in Lahore on September 30 and October 2.
The Indians will tour Pakistan on their way home from Canada after playing a five-match limited overs series against Pakistan in Toronto.
India last toured Pakistan in 1989 under the captaincy of opener Krishnamachari Srikkanth when all four tests were drawn.
